pages.text: $(item)Chunk loaders$() keep their own chunk loaded while they have energy. Use a redstone torch on the block to enable or disable it.$(br2)There's no recipe provided by default.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: Up to two $(item)Emerald crystals$() increase the maximum loaded area; Lua can shape that area into a rectangle. Up to five $(item)Superconductors$() reduce energy use by 10% each.$(br2)Install a $(item)Computer interface$() before calling the CC:Tweaked API. Sneak-use an upgrade or an empty hand to remove one.
